NK - In accordance with MPA Shipping Circular No.10 of 2025, dispensation has been granted on behalf of the Flag Administration for the malfunctioned Exhaust Gas Cleaning System (EGCS) to be repaired not later than 22 November 2026 subject to the following condition:
- The Master shall notify the relevant competent authority as required by regulation 5.6 of MARPOL Annex VI when the ship is calling to a port.
(Opening date: 22 September 2026)
